summary: Sonoma Pharmaceuticals, Inc. filed a prospectus supplement on Form 424B5 to increase the maximum aggregate offering price of common stock available for at-the-market sales under its existing ATM agreement with Ladenburg Thalmann & Co. from $2,070,463 to $3,641,703. As of June 18, 2026, the company's public float was $12,649,011 based on 4,773,212 non-affiliate shares at $2.65 per share. Sales are made under Rule 415 and are limited to one-third of the public float in any 12-month period. This is a routine shelf takedown registration supplement, not a special situation.
